name: Namibia
description: Namibia from the oldest rock art to German South West Africa and the Herero and Nama genocide, South African rule, independence in 1990 and the Namib.

checkpoints.name: The first artists
checkpoints.note: San hunters painted the Apollo 11 cave and carved Twyfelfontein. Herero, Nama and Ovambo lived on the land.

checkpoints.name: German rule
checkpoints.note: Germany seized the land in 1884 and killed most of the Herero and Nama from 1904.

checkpoints.name: South African rule
checkpoints.note: South Africa took the colony in 1915 and brought apartheid. SWAPO fought from 1966.
